entities.name: Martina Dlabajová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martina Dlabajová is a Czech businesswoman and international consultant, former president of the Regional Chamber of Commerce of the Zlín Region. From 2014 to 2024 she had been a Member of the European Parliament.
